card.name: Radiological and virologic response words
card.fires_on: The ending of "radiological" after "radi", and the "-logic" or "response" part of "virologic response". It appears in drug-label text.

modes.label: radiological
modes.description: The word radiological or radiologically, split after "radi", as in imaging studies or evidence of disease.
modes.example: age ≥65 years old, radi<<ological>> studies with contrast, surgery and other procedures

modes.label: virologic response
modes.description: The "-logic" or "response" part of virologic response in antiviral labels.
modes.example: After 24 weeks of treatment, virologic<< response>> should be assessed.

card.plain: It fires on the end of words like radiological and virologic when they are split into pieces, such as radiological studies or virologic response.
